title: cenostigma pinnatum subsp. oblongifolium
intro: Cenostigma pinnatum subsp. oblongifolium, commonly known as the Brazilian ironwood, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of South America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Cenostigma pinnatum subsp. oblongifolium include its use in traditional medicine to treat various conditions, such as fever, pain, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its bioactive constituents. Research has identified the presence of flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other bioactive compounds in this plant, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
